cases.name: addedBy that is not the signer

description: key-hierarchy design §4.1, §4.3, §12 KH1: chains of signed epochs (link, epochSig, carried additions with addSig). The first verifies (N added by A and K joined with the kit during epoch 1; epoch 2 by N removes B and K); the others are the negative vectors: a broken link, a wrong root, an epoch signed by an unlisted key, an addedBy that is not the signer, an epoch introducing a device. Device keys are the strings age1pq1test-<name>. Written by EpochChainTests.
